product_family: CME Globex equity index futures (ES, NQ, YM, RTY and their micro contracts)

authority.primary: CME Globex product-specific trading and holiday schedule as published by CME Group (https://www.cmegroup.com/tools-information/holiday-calendar.html). pandas_market_calendars 'CME Globex Equity' is the machine-readable encoding the builder consumes; the entries below correct that encoding where it disagrees with the published schedule.
authority.secondary: Validated observed NQ/ES tape boundaries (databento *.v.0 native 1s rows). Every entry records the tape evidence it was reconciled against.
authority.not_authoritative: The CME trading-floor close calendar (pandas_market_calendars 'CME_Equity', 12:00 CT holiday-eve closes) whenever it differs from Globex.

entry_schema.session_date: trading-day label (YYYY-MM-DD) of the Globex session, i.e. the calendar day the session closes on
entry_schema.closed: true when the product did not trade at all that session (no prior-evening open); mutually exclusive with market_close_ct
entry_schema.market_close_ct: HH:MM:SS America/Chicago close instant replacing the encoded close
entry_schema.market_open_ct: optional HH:MM:SS America/Chicago open instant on the PRIOR calendar day (only needed when adding a session the encoding lacks)
entry_schema.tape: per-product observed boundary the entry was reconciled against

overrides.reason: National Day of Mourning (President G. H. W. Bush): CME Group closed equity index products at 08:30 CT. The encoding models a full 16:00 CT session.

tape.NQ: last native 1s bar stamped 08:29:59 CT (bar closes 08:30:00); no rows until the 17:00 CT reopen
tape.ES: last native 1s bar stamped 08:29:59 CT; no rows until the 17:00 CT reopen

overrides.reason: Good Friday with no BLS employment-report release: equity index products were closed for the whole session (no Thursday-evening open). The encoding applies an 08:15 CT early close to every Good Friday after 2022; the 08:15 CT session only occurs when the employment report is released that morning (as on 2021-04-02 and 2023-04-07, where the tape confirms it).
